opportunities.name: United flight search from the booking widget
opportunities.description: On the United homepage, search for flights from {origin} to {destination} for {trip_type} on {dates} with {travelers} in {cabin}, optionally paying with miles, then look at or pick a fare.
steps: Open the United homepage Book > Flight tab
Pick Roundtrip or One-way; tick 'Book with miles' if needed
Type the origin city and pick the matching airport suggestion
Type the destination city and pick the matching airport suggestion
Open the Dates picker, go to the right month and click the depart date (and the return date for roundtrip)
Open Travelers and set the number of adults and children
Choose the cabin class if it isn't Economy
Click Find flights
Optionally change the date on the results bar and click Update, open Details/Seats, or choose a fare column

instances.values: One-way, with miles, Sacramento SMF -> Houston IAH, Jun 2, 1 adult
Roundtrip, Baltimore BWI -> New York NYC, Aug 2-Aug 7, 2 adults
Roundtrip, Pune PNQ -> New York NYC, Jun 9-11, 1 adult, picked the fully refundable Economy fare
Roundtrip, Mumbai BOM -> London LON, Jul 1-5, 2 adults + 1 child (12-14), Premium economy
One-way, Springfield SPI -> Austin AUS, Jun 9 then changed to Apr 29, 1 adult, opened Details/Seats
Roundtrip, Santa Fe SAF -> Phoenix PHX, Aug 13-Aug 28, 1 adult, picked the $681 Economy fare

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, find parking for {event} at {venue}, optionally on {event_date}, then apply {filters}, set entry/exit {times} or a sort order, and update the results.
steps: Type the venue into 'Search for parking' and pick the matching suggestion
In the venue events dialog, optionally pick an event date, then click the event
Optionally open Filter, tick a filter (e.g. Wheelchair Accessible) and click Show N Results
Optionally change the Start/End time and click Update Search
Optionally change Sort (Distance/Price)
Optionally click Book Now on a listing

instances.values: Barclays Center, Orlando Magic at Brooklyn Nets, 3:00 PM-5:00 PM, clicked Book Now
Busch Stadium, Pirates at Cardinals Apr 13, Wheelchair Accessible, sorted by Price
Barclays Center, Apr 9 76ers at Brooklyn Nets, Wheelchair Accessible, start time 10:00 AM

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor restaurant search by location with filter
opportunities.description: On Tripadvisor, open Restaurants, search for {location}, pick it, and apply a {filter} such as a cuisine, dietary restriction or feature.
steps: Click Restaurants on the Tripadvisor home page
Type the location into the 'Where to?' search and pick the matching result
Optionally click 'More restaurants in ...' or 'Limit search to ...'
Click 'Show more' in the filter group if needed, tick the filter (cuisine/dietary/feature) and click Apply

instances.values: Central Park New York, Italian cuisine
Los Angeles, Indian cuisine, limited the search to LA

opportunities.name: United Explore destinations map search
opportunities.description: On United's Explore destinations map, search for destinations flying from {origin} with a {trip_type} and {date_mode}, then look at the results.
steps: Open Book > Map search (Explore destinations)
Type the origin into 'Flying from' and pick the airport suggestion
Optionally set the trip type (Roundtrip) and Dates (Flexible dates)
Click Search
Optionally open 'List of search results' and click a destination

instances.values: Phoenix PHX, opened the list of results
Las Vegas LAS, Roundtrip, Flexible dates
